name: After § 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
part_text: 2a. Emphasises that endemic corruption and poor governance are the main causes of Haiti’s security and humanitarian crisis, fuelling gang violence; notes that since the Duvalier family’s dictatorship, there has been a strong linkage between Haiti’s political and economic elites and gangs; expresses serious concerns about allegations of corruption within Haiti’s transitional governing bodies;
